findings.text: Final release evidence is incomplete and contradicts the approved SLICE-004 exit contract. The approved specification and plan require TS-STATIC-001, the complete TS-TEST-012 Play checklist, and TS-TEST-016: one positive configured cloud GUI asset smoke in the exact selected published place with recorded AllowInsertFreeAssets=false. The synchronized handoff/worklog record only the 15/15 focused runtime suite, root/host observation, identity, and controller repository/build checks; they record no static-analysis fixture result, no pointer/gamepad/safe-area/configured-window Play evidence, and no positive cloud-smoke/setting evidence. Production TemplateWindowConfig is still the intentionally empty sequence, so no configured production AssetId exists with which TS-TEST-016 could have passed. Consequently the claims that the four-slice candidate is fully verified and SLICE-004 QA passed are not supported by the documented candidate evidence. Do not advance to ready until these mandatory gates are truthfully evidenced or the approved authority is revised through its public workflow.
